idea-plugin.name: MCC Port Forwarder
idea-plugin.description:
MCC Port Forwarder

Manage port forwarding connections directly from IntelliJ IDEA.

Features:

  • Manage services and hosts hierarchically
  • Multiple port mappings per host
  • Multi-datacenter support with location templates
  • Real-time connection status tracking
  • Start/stop individual ports or entire services
  • Auto-retry on connection failure
  • Kill blocking processes on ports
  • Configuration import/export
  • Detailed logging per port

Status Indicators:

  • 🔵 Connecting - Process started
  • 🟡 Authenticating - Authentication in progress
  • 🟢 Ready - Connection established
  • 🔴 Error - Connection failed
  • 🟠 Timeout - Connection timeout
  • 🟠 Port Busy - Port already in use
  • 🔄 Restarting - Auto-retry in progress
  • 🟣 Disconnected - Connection dropped
